properties.level_of_theory: Gaussian 16 RevC.01, PM7, gas phase, charge 0, electronic energy scale as printed by Gaussian (PM7 reference scale)
properties.bond_dissociation_energy_convention: D_e (electronic, harmonic ZPE excluded), gas phase, charge 0. Defined as E(PM7 minimum of N2 at r_eq = 1.1194 A) minus E(2 free ground-state N atoms, 2 x 4S, i.e. the septet limit). The septet asymptote was taken at r = 20.00 A where the curve is flat and equals 2 x E(one N atom, mult 4) to 1.5e-8 hartree. It is NOT taken from the multiplicity-1 restricted closed-shell branch, which is not an asymptote (see notes).
properties.bond_dissociation_energy_D0_convention: D_0 = D_e - ZPE(N2); ZPE = 0.0057434 hartree = 3.60 kcal/mol (2521.07 cm-1) from the PM7 Opt+Freq log; the two separated N atoms have no ZPE.
properties.bond_dissociation_energy_experimental_kc: 225.0 (D_0) / 228.4 (D_e), 9.76 eV; PM7 underestimates the N2 bond strength by ~35 kcal/mol at this level of theory

dissociation_curve.description: PM7 rigid single-point scan of the two-atom N-N distance (exact for a diatomic: the bond length is the only internal degree of freedom). Energies relative to the PM7 minimum at r_eq = 1.1194 A (E = 0.0525726877431 hartree). Two spin branches were scanned: mult 1 (restricted closed-shell singlet, the ground state of bonded N2) and mult 7 (highest-spin, dissociating to 2 x 4S N atoms). 'ground_state_lowest' is the lower of the two branches at each r; the branches cross at r = 1.69 A.

units.energy_rel: kcal/mol relative to the PM7 minimum
units.energy_abs: hartree (PM7 scale as printed by Gaussian 16)

properties.notes: Ground-state dissociation of N2 to two 4S N atoms is spin-forbidden; the mult-1 restricted closed-shell branch stays on an unphysical ionic-like wall and keeps rising (598.74 kcal/mol at 6 A, 619.18 at 8 A, 631.63 at 10 A), so it was discarded as an asymptote (plateau test required by the Supervisor). It is nevertheless the correct description of the bonded minimum and of the inner repulsive wall (0.90-1.60 A). The mult-7 branch is monotone decreasing from 0.90 to 4.00 A (a 0.10 kcal/mol dispersion shelf at 4 A) and flat to 20 A. Multiplicity 1 is the declared state of N2; the septet asymptote is the proper electronic ground-state limit of the separated atoms.
properties.additional_supporting_logs_in_workspace: pm7/scan/r<d>.log (24 mult-1 points of the curve), pm7/scan7/r<d>_mult7.log (24 mult-7 points), pm7/n2_pair_r20p00_mult7.log and pm7/n2_atom_N_mult4.log (asymptote cross-check), pm7/summary.md

properties.level_of_theory: Gaussian 16 RevC.01, PM7, gas phase, charge 0
properties.description: Dissociated limit: two ground-state N(4S) atoms, total multiplicity 7 (2 x 4S), UPM7, <S**2> = 12.0000 at every distance (no spin contamination). Characterised by rigid single points at 6.00, 8.00, 10.00 and 20.00 A plus an optimized stationary point at r = 3.9531 A (the shallow long-range dispersion minimum of the two-atom system, binding 0.10 kcal/mol, one real mode 27.75 cm-1, NImag = 0). The N-N bond is fully broken there: this is a non-bonded 2N supermolecule, not a chemical bond.
properties.long_range_stationary_point_description: Gaussian PM7 '#p PM7 Opt Freq' started at r = 4.00 A (mult 7) converges to a genuine UPM7 stationary point: r = 3.9531 A, E = 0.359986106 Eh, one real mode 27.7468 cm-1, NImag = 0, <S**2> = 12.0, normal termination (pm7/final/n2_pair_r4p00_mult7_optfreq.log). It is the ~0.105 kcal/mol long-range N-N dispersion well, i.e. a non-bonded 2N supermolecule; it is NOT a chemical bond and NOT the BDE reference. The 6.00 A frequency jobs show negative curvature only because 6 A lies outside that well.
properties.bde_asymptote_choice: The declared BDE uses the plateaued 20.00 A / 2 x E(N,4S) value, not this 3.95 A well; the difference is 0.105 kcal/mol.
properties.asymptote: 0.3601539097 Eh at r = 20.00 A (all numeric curve and BDE values are declared on the reactant node)
properties.two_isolated_atoms_cross_check: 2 x E(N, 4S) = 0.3601539248 Eh, equal to the 20 A plateau to 1.5e-8 Eh
properties.singlet_restricted_branch_note: The multiplicity-1 restricted closed-shell pair is not a physical asymptote (still climbing at 10 A); it is reported only in the dissociation_curve of the reactant node.
properties.pair_frequency_note: Frequency jobs on the 6.00 A pair give one imaginary mode each: -5.1092 cm-1 (mult 7) and -78.5007 cm-1 (mult 1), i.e. 6 A lies outside the 3.95 A dispersion well; the 3.95 A optimisation itself has one real mode, 27.7468 cm-1, NImag = 0.
properties.additional_supporting_logs_in_workspace: pm7/n2_pair_r20p00_mult7.log and pm7/n2_atom_N_mult4.log (asymptote and 2 x E(N,4S)), pm7/scan7/ (mult-7 scan), pm7/n2_pair_sp.log, pm7/summary.md

edges.channel: barrierless homolytic N-N bond dissociation; singlet -> 2 x 4S atomic limit (spin-forbidden curve crossing at r = 1.69 A)
edges.note: No transition state exists: the potential is monotonic in the only internal coordinate (N-N stretch), and frequency analyses of the stretched pair give one imaginary mode (-5.11 cm-1 mult 7, -78.50 cm-1 mult 1) but no first-order saddle point. ts_opt/frequency/short_irc are therefore not applicable for this step. bond_changes use the atom-map indices of [N:1]#[N:2].
